title: Read Bits Legally
prompt: Implement `unsigned int float_bits(float f)` returning the 32 bits of f's representation. The cast chain `*(unsigned *)&f` is the UB trap; copy the bytes instead — either via `memcpy`, or through an `unsigned char` walk you accumulate into an unsigned.

tests.name: 1.0f representation
tests.hint: memcpy into an unsigned; 1.0f is exponent 127, mantissa 0.

tests.name: 0.0f representation
tests.hint: All representation bytes of +0.0f are zero.
